state.question: What was this building's original role, and what was its construction year?
state.answer: This building was originally Georgia Tech’s first purpose-built library, and it was constructed in 1907.
state.supplied_evidence: Building record (paraphrased from https://provost.gatech.edu/news/renewal-gets-real-library-next-site): The Carnegie Building was built in 1907 as Georgia Tech's first purpose-built library.
